TXWC_WarcasketHelmet_Toxin.description.english:
Specialized warcasket helmet with superior protection and worse weight, fitted with a respirator that keeps out tox gas and draws it back into the tank.

The 7th generation warcaskets came after underwhelming results in improving the baseline performance even further, instead focusing on creating designs that - while interchangeable - work better as a set. They were also the first to include plasteel in the design as it appeared more frequently in scavenging and looting. Each piece has a unique function that synergizes with those of the same series, making them a truly separate class of mobile armor units.

The Toxin series is based on the Cataphract design, with the frame rebuilt around a tox gas tank for chemical warfare. The tank in the shell feeds vents around the pilot and the gas jets on the pauldrons, and the respirator in the helmet draws gas back into it. The objective was a pilot who could gas a position and then walk into it, and clear the air again once the fighting was done. Together the pieces make the pilot immune to environmental toxins.

TXWC_WarcasketHelmet_Toxin.shortDescript.english: Specialized warcasket helmet with superior protection and worse weight, fitted with a respirator that keeps out tox gas and draws it back into the tank.

TXWC_WarcasketShoulders_Toxin.comps.Comp.english: Spray a cone of tox gas from the shoulders at the target. The gas will spread outward from where it lands and thin as it drifts. Each jet draws chemfuel from the warcasket's tank. If no tank is worn, the shoulders will use a small reserve of their own, which must be reloaded with chemfuel.

TXWC_AbsorbGas.description.english: Draw the surrounding air in through the respirator for a few seconds. Smoke, tox gas and other gases near the pilot will be pulled in and cleared, even as they move. If a tank is worn, whatever is drawn in will be filtered and stored in it as tox gas.

TXWC_VentTank.description.english: Open the tank's vents and release tox gas around the pilot. The cloud will grow from wherever the pilot stands and follow them as they move. Toggle again to close the vents and keep what is left.
